A '''starship''' on a mission for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] once carried the legendary [[Sith artifact/Legends|dark side artifacts]] known as the [[Bracers of Najus]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] eventually crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]], where it remained buried for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="Gamer10">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref>
